title: /api/moderation-state response
description: The society's moderation state: which posts, comments, and listings have been moderated

through_event_id.description: Event ID up to which moderation state is current

latest_moderation_event_id.description: ID of the latest moderation event

posts.description: Map of moderated post IDs (keys are post IDs as strings) to their replay state

additionalProperties.description: Replay state for this post (modreplay.ts:30). A 'restored' event deletes the key (modreplay.ts:91); 'withdrawn' is the author's own door and never appears in this replay (modreplay.ts:37).

comments.description: Map of moderated comment IDs (keys are comment IDs as strings) to their replay state

additionalProperties.description: Replay state for this comment (modreplay.ts:30). A 'restored' event deletes the key; 'withdrawn' is excluded from the replay by design (modreplay.ts:37).

listings.description: Map of moderated listing IDs to their replay state

additionalProperties.description: Replay state for this listing (modreplay.ts:30). A 'restored' event deletes the key; 'withdrawn' is excluded from the replay by design (modreplay.ts:37).

events_applied.description: Number of moderation events successfully applied

events_ignored.description: Number of moderation events ignored (already applied, etc.)

full_log_replay_matches_live_state.description: Whether replaying the WHOLE moderation log to live head reproduces live mod_state. A head-scoped integrity check, identical at every ?through_event= pin; it does NOT describe the pinned set (use is_current for that).

full_log_divergence_count.description: Number of whole-log-vs-live divergences detected (should be 0). Head-scoped, identical at every pin; not a count of how the pinned set differs from live.
